rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: DESeq2 Wald on ~condition with chow as reference, all 12 samples kept with a diagnostic QC (library sizes, size factors, blind VST PCA, correlation heatmap) and an evidence-based keep/flag policy plus a leave-one-out sensitivity run, apeglm shrinkage and BH at 0.05, and fgsea preranked on the full Wald-statistic list against the mouse MSigDB Hallmark collection (MGI symbols, version 2026.1) with the symbol-overlap fraction reported and an explicit ORA universe. Minor deductions: the low-count filter is offered as two alternative rules with 'e.g.' rather than one fixed, justified rule; the |log2FC|>1 count is a post hoc filter rather than an lfcThreshold in the test; the set-size window is 10-500 rather than 15-500; and fgsea/apeglm versions are not stated although DESeq2 and MSigDB versions are.
